A '''giant frog''' is a monster found in the [[Lumbridge Swamp Caves]] and [[Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon]]. 

At level 33, they are the toughest monster in the swamp caves. Three can be found on the south-eastern part of the cave complex, located just next to the entrance to [[Juna]]'s [[Tears of Guthix Cavern|cavern]], on a platform accessible by jumping over a stepping stone in the water. If one fails the jump and falls into the water, their [[Light sources|light source]] will get extinguished and will require to be reignited. All [[Candle lantern|Candle Lanterns]] you are carrying would break into useless [[broken glass]], leaving you with just a [[candle]]. For this reason, it is recommended to use a [[Seer's headband 1|Seers Headband]] or [[Bullseye lantern (lit)|Bullseye Lantern]] so you will not risk breaking your light source or an [[Light sources#Explosion of gas|explosion of gas]] in the caves.

Their frequent drops of [[nature runes]] and [[giant frog legs]] combined to their closeness to the [[Lumbridge Castle]] and [[Culinaromancer's Chest]] banks, can also make training fairly profitable for lower levelled players. The occasional drop of [[cosmic rune]]s also make them a worthwhile grind for a lower levelled ([[Hardcore Ironman Mode|Hardcore]]) [[Ironman Mode|Ironman]] character, who might be in need of those to [[Jewellery enchantment|enchant jewellery]], especially acquiring the [[ring of Luck]] early on in the game.

==Trivia==
* This monster was the only non-[[Slayer monster]] to drop [[Metal boots]]. It used to share this characteristic with [[Nex]], who could drop [[dragon boots]], but this was changed in a [[hidden update]] that removed the boots from Nex's drop table.
* The giant frog used to be a melee monster, but after the [[Evolution of Combat]] update it has changed its style to ranged.
